subject.title: fix(memory-core): keep same-agent session hits in memory recall under tree visibility (#103732)

question: Should memory recall expose unrelated same-agent historical sessions that the default `tree` session-history boundary denies?
rationale: Current source, docs, and merged feature history define a shared boundary, while the reported expectation requires widening historical transcript access; this product/security contract cannot be selected mechanically.

options.title: Preserve shared tree semantics
options.body: Remove the default-only bypass and SDK helper, and use `tools.sessions.visibility: "agent"` for agent-wide historical recall.

options.title: Approve a shared policy change
options.body: Widen session history and memory recall together with owner approval, documentation, compatibility analysis, and security proof.

options.title: Add an explicit recall mode
options.body: Design a separate opt-in recall boundary if memory intentionally needs different semantics from session-history tools.

recommendation.title: Preserve shared tree semantics
recommendation.body: Remove the default-only bypass and SDK helper, and use `tools.sessions.visibility: "agent"` for agent-wide historical recall.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed, approved, and merged the original shared visibility contract and are the strongest history-backed owner for changing it.
